## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle composite work combines [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's Northern-Sòng abridgement (*jié yào* 節要) of the *Yí jiào jīng lùn* 遺教經論 ([KR6g0044](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0044)) commentarial tradition with [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) Yúnqī Zhūhóng's late-Míng supplementary annotation (*bǔ zhù* 補註).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1067–1615) reflects the period from Jìngyuán's Northern-Sòng activity to Zhūhóng's late-Míng supplementary work.
